headline: AMETEK posts record Q3 sales, raises full-year guidance
summary: AMETEK reported record third-quarter sales of $2.22 billion, up 17% year-over-year, and raised its full-year financial guidance.
why: Electronic instruments and electromechanical materials manufacturers serve as bellwethers for industrial automation, aerospace, and defense capital expenditures.
